Start date: 2001-07-05  
Subtract 46 weeks: 46 × 7 = 322 days.  
Add 1 extra day to subtract: total 323 days before.  

2001-07-05 minus 323 days:  
July 5 → back to June (30 days in June): 5 days into July, so back 5 days → June 30, 2001.  
Remaining days: 323 − 5 = 318 days earlier.  
From June 30, 2001, go into 2001 and then 2000.  
2001 is not a leap year (2000 is leap year).  

From June 30, 2001:  
Back through 2001: Jan 1 to June 30 = 181 days (2001 non-leap).  
318 − 181 = 137 days left into 2000.  
2000 is leap year, so Feb has 29 days.  
From Dec 31, 2000, go back 137 days:  
Dec 31 → back 31 days (Dec) → Nov 30, 2000.  
137 − 31 = 106 days left.  
Nov 30 → back 30 days (Nov) → Oct 31, 2000.  
106 − 30 = 76 days left.  
Oct 31 → back 31 days (Oct) → Sep 30, 2000.  
76 − 31 = 45 days left.  
Sep 30 → back 30 days (Sep) → Aug 31, 2000.  
45 − 30 = 15 days left.  
Go back 15 days from Aug 31 → Aug 16, 2000.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2000-08-16
